column1: # Java package -> Go package (relative to go/), one per line, tab separated.
# Hand maintained. migration/scripts/inventory.ps1 reads this file to attribute
# Java source to Go packages, and reports any Java package missing from it.
#   - the fontbox and xmpbox modules keep their own trees
#   - a package whose last segment collides with a standard library package is
#     renamed; the only such rename so far is io -> pdfio
#   - documentinterchange and documentnavigation lose the redundant middle
